title: 第407章 被抓了
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

查了火车站售票记录，发现她们买了当天早上回黑省的火车票。

跑得了和尚跑不了庙。

草坝县公安局的公安在火车站出站口等着她们。

田母和田小娥刚下火车，就被带上了警车。

两人会跑，是因为终于意识到了事情败露的严重性。

田母原本还想跟林家犟到底，想着只要咬死了不松口，林家拿她也没办法。

可田小娥冷静下来之后越想越怕。

林家连她们下药的事都能查出来，未必就查不到她去找了别的男人。

林家给她们办住院，不是妥协，是在等证据。

只要他们把那些事查清楚，知道了她肚子里的孩子不是林秉轩的，一定会把她们交到公安手里。

田小娥现在得了这种病，肚子里的孩子肯定保不住。

万一被抓进去，判了劳改，那她就只有死路一条。

巨大的恐惧压垮了她最后的侥幸，她连夜哭着劝田母赶紧走。

田母一开始还不死心，还想硬扛到底。

可被女儿一番分析吓得浑身发凉，总算不敢再犟了。

母女俩连夜收拾了东西，天不亮就办了出院，直奔火车站，买了最早一班回黑省的票。

一路上田母还在念叨：“没事的没事的，老家是咱们的地盘，回去了他们还能追过来不成。”

没想到，刚到草坝县，就被当地公安堵了个正着。

证据确凿，两人自然是抵赖不了的。

田母一看那些证据，立马变了脸，把罪责都推到女儿身上。

“都是她！都是她自己的主意！药是我买的没错，可那是她让我去买的！那些男人也是她自己去找的！跟我没关系！我什么都不知道！”

“妈！是你让我去找那些男人的。是你说的，只要能怀上孩子，不管是谁的都行，往林秉轩头上一扣，咱就能去京市享福。你现在说是我的主意？”

田母和田小娥当场就撕了起来，互相推诿，演了一出狗咬狗的戏码。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After checking the ticket sales records at the train station, it was found that they bought train tickets back to Black Province that morning.

A monk who can run away cannot run away from the temple.

Officers from the Caoba County Public Security Bureau were waiting for them at the train station exit.

Tian's mother and Tian Xiao'e were taken into a police car as soon as they got off the train.

The two ran away because they finally realized the seriousness of the matter.

Tian's mother originally wanted to fight the Lin family to the end, thinking that as long as she refused to let go, the Lin family would have nothing to do with her.

But after Tian Xiao'e calmed down, the more she thought about it, the more frightened she became.

The Lin family could even find out about their drugging, so it might not be impossible to find out that she went to find another man.

The Lin family put them in hospital, not because they were compromising, but because they were waiting for evidence.

As long as they find out those things clearly and know that the child in her belly is not Lin Bingxuan's, they will definitely hand them over to the police.

Tian Xiao'e has this disease now, and the baby in her belly will definitely not be saved.

If she was caught and sentenced to forced labor, she would have no choice but to die.

The huge fear overwhelmed her last chance, and she cried all night to persuade Tian's mother to leave quickly.

Tian’s mother didn’t give up at first and wanted to fight to the end.

But after being frightened by my daughter's analysis, I felt cold all over, and finally I didn't dare to be stubborn anymore.

The mother and daughter packed their things overnight and were discharged from the hospital before dawn. They went straight to the train station and bought tickets for the earliest train back to Black Province.

Tian's mother was still mumbling along the way: "It's okay, it's okay. Our hometown is our territory. If we go back, they can still catch us."

Unexpectedly, as soon as I arrived in Caoba County, I was blocked by the local police.

The evidence is conclusive, and the two people naturally cannot deny it.

When Tian's mother saw the evidence, she immediately changed her face and put all the blame on her daughter.

"It's all her! It's all her own idea! I bought the medicine, yes, but she asked me to buy it! She also went to find those men by herself! It has nothing to do with me! I don't know anything!"

"Mom! It was you who asked me to find those men. It was you who said that as long as we can conceive a child, no matter whose it is, just slap Lin Bingxuan on the head, and we can go to the capital to enjoy life. Are you saying it was my idea now?"

Tian's mother and Tian Xiao'e started fighting on the spot, blaming each other and acting out a dog-eat-dog drama.
